name: gemini-fullstack-monorepo
description: Fullstack monorepo featuring React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Express TypeScript, @google/genai, MongoDB, and FastAPI

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run dev:pipeline"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
